summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow. Changes: pytorch.json and tensorflow.json each gain one inference_graviton section (alias to 1.12.1 / 2.9.1, py38, pytorch-inference-graviton / tensorflow-inference-graviton, 26 registries, cpu ubuntu20.04); fw_utils.py gains GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS; image_uris.py gains the private _graviton_image_scope helper called before config load, plus the -sagemaker suffix for the Graviton repo; tests add test_graviton.py (test_graviton_pytorch, test_graviton_tensorflow), graviton_framework_uri in expected_uris.py, and two module-scoped fixtures in tests/conftest.py. Verification: both new tests pass; the runnable image_uris suite passes (663 passed). Unverified: test_retrieve.py and jumpstart/ could not be collected because the shared venv lacks the mock package. Caveat: the venv resolves sagemaker to a separate base/ checkout, so tests were run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src/. Nothing was committed.
